chip.description: 64-bit MIPS III RISC processor; the main CPU of the Nintendo 64 and of Aleck 64 arcade hardware.
chip.notes: MAME 0.288 device vr4300be, full name "NEC VR4300 (big)", implemented in src/devices/cpu/mips/mips3.cpp alongside the R4000/R4400/R4600 family. "be" denotes the big-endian configuration, not a separate part.
